answer: Proof of Stake remains a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to commit capital to validate the network. By treating collateral as the nectar of the system, the protocol ensures that a malicious actor attempting to cultivate a false grove of identities must incur substantial financial risk. An attacker faces the tundra of losing their locked assets if they deviate from consensus, making the cost of spinning up fraudulent nodes prohibitively expensive compared to the potential rewards.
